candidate_claims.statement: The source observation is titled 'Stiff Person Syndrome'.
The severity and progression of SPS can vary from one person to another.
candidate_claims.supporting_excerpt: The severity and progression of SPS can vary from one person to another.

candidate_claims.statement: The symptoms usually develop over a period of months to years and may remain stable for many years or slowly worsen.
candidate_claims.supporting_excerpt: The symptoms usually develop over a period of months to years and may remain stable for many years or slowly worsen.

candidate_claims.statement: Affected individuals may initially experience aching discomfort, stiffness, or pain, especially in the lower back, hips, and/or legs (predominantly in the classic type).
candidate_claims.supporting_excerpt: Affected individuals may initially experience aching discomfort, stiffness, or pain, especially in the lower back, hips, and/or legs (predominantly in the classic type).

candidate_claims.statement: Early on, stiffness may come and go, but it can gradually become fixed.
candidate_claims.supporting_excerpt: Early on, stiffness may come and go, but it can gradually become fixed.

candidate_claims.statement: The shoulders, arms, and/or neck may also be affected and less commonly the face.
candidate_claims.supporting_excerpt: The shoulders, arms, and/or neck may also be affected and less commonly the face.

candidate_claims.statement: As the disease progresses, stiffness of the leg muscles (and other body regions) develops and can be more pronounced on one side than the other (asymmetrical).
candidate_claims.supporting_excerpt: As the disease progresses, stiffness of the leg muscles (and other body regions) develops and can be more pronounced on one side than the other (asymmetrical).

candidate_claims.statement: This leads to a slow, stiff manner of walking.
candidate_claims.supporting_excerpt: This leads to a slow, stiff manner of walking.

candidate_claims.statement: As stiffness increases, affected individuals may develop an increasingly arched lower back due to inward curving of the lower spine (hyperlordosis).
candidate_claims.supporting_excerpt: As stiffness increases, affected individuals may develop an increasingly arched lower back due to inward curving of the lower spine (hyperlordosis).

candidate_claims.statement: In addition to muscular rigidity/stiffness, individuals with SPS also develop muscle spasms, which may occur for no apparent reason (spontaneously) or in response to various triggering events (i.e., stimuli).
candidate_claims.supporting_excerpt: In addition to muscular rigidity/stiffness, individuals with SPS also develop muscle spasms, which may occur for no apparent reason (spontaneously) or in response to various triggering events (i.e., stimuli).

candidate_claims.statement: Spasms can be triggered by unexpected or loud noises, minor physical contact, cold environments, stress or situations that cause a heightened emotional response.
candidate_claims.supporting_excerpt: Spasms can be triggered by unexpected or loud noises, minor physical contact, cold environments, stress or situations that cause a heightened emotional response.

candidate_claims.statement: Muscle spasms are often very painful and usually worsen existing stiffness.
candidate_claims.supporting_excerpt: Muscle spasms are often very painful and usually worsen existing stiffness.

candidate_claims.statement: The spasms may involve the entire body or only a specific body region.
candidate_claims.supporting_excerpt: The spasms may involve the entire body or only a specific body region.

candidate_claims.statement: The legs are often involved, which may lead to falls.
candidate_claims.supporting_excerpt: The legs are often involved, which may lead to falls.

candidate_claims.statement: Spasms of abdominal muscles may lead to individuals feeling bloated and constricted around their torso.
candidate_claims.supporting_excerpt: Spasms of abdominal muscles may lead to individuals feeling bloated and constricted around their torso.

candidate_claims.statement: Spasms involving the chest and respiratory muscles can be serious, potentially requiring emergency medical treatment with ventilatory support.
candidate_claims.supporting_excerpt: Spasms involving the chest and respiratory muscles can be serious, potentially requiring emergency medical treatment with ventilatory support.
